meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 dial 命令用一个真实电话号码发短信、拨打由 AI 接听的语音电话，并等待、读取收到的短信和验证码。首次用到某个命令时，它会先查该命令的 --help。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、短信、验证码等词，或要求发短信、打电话、等验证码时触发；本会话首次运行 dial 命令前也会加载。

say.note: AI 语音代理按指令通话

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use a real phone number through the dial CLI to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and wait for and read inbound texts and codes. It runs a command's --help first when that verb is new in the session.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phones, texts, SMS, voice, OTP or 2FA codes, or ask to text, call, or wait for a code; also loaded before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.note: AI voice agent follows the instruction

say_en.text: Wait for an SMS code and tell me what it says
